intro: Warm and grounded, our Diner dining table in expresso offers the perfect blend of rich tone, stability, and everyday function—made to bring people together.

features.title: Rich espresso finish
features.text: A deep, elegant expresso tone gives the lacquered MDF top a luxurious appeal that feels both premium and welcoming in your home.

features.title: Durable MDF surface
features.text: The lacquer-coated surface adds extra resilience to scratches and spills, so your table keeps its fresh, polished look longer.

features.title: Strong rubberwood base
features.text: With a solid rubberwood frame, this table is built to handle daily meals, weekend dinners, and all the moments in between.

features.title: Roomy, angular legs
features.text: Placed at the corners, the angular legs create generous leg space and give the table a bold, contemporary edge.

features.title: Safe, stylish curves
features.text: Smooth, rounded edges enhance safety and lend a refined finish to the design—comfort and style, all in one.

name: Diner 6-Seater Rectangular Solidwood Dining Table
